metadata.description: Seed-robust repaired selected configuration for perc_full64. Hyperparameters are candidate c07 (forest trial 46) of perc_full64_optimizer_search_v003, chosen by a validation-only 15-seed median rule.

final_seed_choice.note: Deliberately NOT the best-performing seed. The locked model must be typical of the seed distribution, not a lucky tail draw.
final_seed_choice.rule: the rerank seed whose validation horizon is CLOSEST TO THE 15-SEED MEDIAN

finite_fraction_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (decisions D3/D6). finite_fraction was NOT used to filter or rank candidates. It records long-rollout boundedness, which the horizon metric does not penalise.

metadata.recovery_note: Non-winner trial directories were not retained by this search. Hyperparameters were recovered by the VALIDATED run_id reconstruction: continuous dims decoded at full precision from the run_id, categoricals from the results CSV (exactly representable), fixed flags from the tracked search config, seed from the documented formula. The method was proven BIT-EXACT (10/10 fields) against this search's surviving winner trial before use. No truncated CSV float was ever used for a continuous field.
metadata.selection_rule: Highest MEDIAN valid_relative_l2_horizon_time across 15 fresh seeds (9403101-9403115), then mean, then min, then median valid_relative_l2_mean, then smaller candidate rank. Validation only — no test metric was used at any stage.
metadata.supersede_reason: The superseded config reported valid_h 45.300000000000004, which the lightweight seed screen showed lies ABOVE the entire range of fresh seeds. Its seed was the winning trial's seed, i.e. selected for being lucky (optimizer_search_*.py assigns a different seed to every trial and the selected config inherits the winner's).
metadata.test_policy: evaluate_test=true and append_registry=true exactly once after validation-only selection
